missing: How many hours each unit actually ran a real outage load, like a fridge plus lights and a CPAP, and how much solar recharge it got per day in typical sun, compared at each price point.
why: Consumer Reports and OutdoorGearLab both lab-test power stations and talk directly about outage and blackout use. Good Housekeeping and Popular Mechanics add tested roundups with blackout or home-backup picks. With four or more major reviewers answering this exact question with their own testing, a new page would not push them out.
